checks: Exact named synthetic native tests; paired syntax projection
cost: Index O(title bytes plus entries), expected hash lookups. For T item tokens and C title candidates of length L, contained O(T+C*(L+T+authors)) plus span sorting and overlap scans O(S²); raw token/string costs additional. Library scans bounded directory depth and reads YAML; no downloads.
description: Unicode token folding retains original UTF-8 byte boundaries. Index stores first id/DOI and full/article-skipped title variants. Matcher gathers URL and ACL DOI ids, other DOIs, bibtex, then library titles followed by ACL titles; contained ranks longest spans first and skips overlaps. best prefers exact year, author count, ACL-bearing record then index. lift maps ACL match into library by anthology id; duplicates keep first method. near records exactly-one-failed checks and excludes final hits.
forward: Unicode token folding retains original UTF-8 byte boundaries. Index stores first id/DOI and full/article-skipped title variants. Matcher gathers URL and ACL DOI ids, other DOIs, bibtex, then library titles followed by ACL titles; contained ranks longest spans first and skips overlaps. best prefers exact year, author count, ACL-bearing record then index. lift maps ACL match into library by anthology id; duplicates keep first method. near records exactly-one-failed checks and excludes final hits.
inverse: Hit preimages include explicit id strings and normalized title/author/year variants; normalization is many-to-one, and best tie-break loses candidate identities except selected alts. Not a unique paper correctness proof.

Missing author/year/boundary cannot become free-title hit unless allowed fuzzy year/boundary alternatives apply. Short titles (<3 words or <20 chars) never enter trigram search. Explicit identifiers can still match without those title constraints.
limitations: Partial source models and finite fixtures only. No corpus/model/network/site/release execution or universal proof.
state: Bounded helper inputs and source-derived CLI state/effects; see catalog.
